targets.rawSql:
SELECT source_key,
       plant_id,
       point_id,
       point_name,
       point_type,
       metric,
       display_name,
       device_id,
       candidate_device_count,
       candidate_device_ids,
       created_at,
       '编辑' AS edit,
       '删除' AS delete
FROM admin_api.v_point_metric_source
ORDER BY plant_id, point_id, metric;

panels.title: 指标来源绑定（决定监控页默认显示哪台设备）

targets.rawSql: SELECT point_id, metric, device_id FROM point_metric_source WHERE point_id = split_part(${edit_source_key:sqlstring}, '|', 1) AND metric = split_part(${edit_source_key:sqlstring}, '|', 2) LIMIT 1;
SELECT '' AS value, '（新建）' AS label UNION ALL SELECT source_key AS value, (plant_id || ' / ' || point_id || ' / ' || metric) AS label FROM admin_api.v_point_metric_source ORDER BY label;

SELECT pt.point_id AS value, (pt.plant_id || ' / ' || pt.point_id || CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(pt.point_name), ''), '') <> '' THEN ' (' || pt.point_name || ')' ELSE '' END) AS label FROM point pt ORDER BY pt.plant_id, pt.point_id;
SELECT md.metric AS value, (COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(md.display_name), ''), md.metric) || ' [' || md.metric || ']') AS label FROM metric_dict md ORDER BY md.metric;

SELECT d.device_id AS value, (pt.plant_id || ' / ' || d.point_id || ' / ' || d.device_id) AS label FROM device d JOIN point pt ON pt.point_id = d.point_id ORDER BY pt.plant_id, d.point_id, d.device_id;
